_header: Credits that the MAM change logs, gh-pages/MAM-with-doc/change-log/, show for changes that people other than Ben Denckla and Avi Kadish reported or suggested.
Hand-maintained. A credit is recorded only on Ben's word; Avi's requests reach it through Ben (Ben's decision of 2026-11-19, doc/PLAN-change-log-credits.md, decision 2).

py/main_diff.py mpplus puts each record on the change-log entry at its book, chapter and verse that holds its change, one of the entry's changes pairs, or its templates, equal to a structural entry's templates_added and templates_removed. py/mb_diff_mpu/mpplus_credits.py validates the file and names the keys and evidence kinds it takes.
Every run that regenerates the whole change log, as --all, --check, --pin and the mega's diff-mpplus step do, stops unless each record matches exactly one entry.
Copy a record's Hebrew forms from the change log's JSON by script, never by typing them: an editor can reorder marks, and the match is exact.

recorded.basis: Ben's decision of 2026-11-19 on Avi's request
